voting_record.statement: Bonamici voted No on the House motion to concur in the Senate amendment to H.R. 1, the One Big Beautiful Bill Act, on July 3, 2025 (Roll Call 190, 218-214).
voting_record.excerpt: QUESTION: On Motion to Concur in the Senate Amendment … BILL TITLE: One Big Beautiful Bill Act … ---- NOES 214 --- … Bonamici

voting_record.statement: Bonamici voted Nay on House passage of S. 5, the Laken Riley Act, on January 22, 2025 (Roll Call 23, 263-156).

collection_notes: Steps 4-6 (open-web and T3 press searches) could not be completed for every candidate because the WebSearch budget shared by all agents in this run ran out (searches marked 'blocked' in collection_log were not run); searches that did run produced no items that were used. To keep effort equal, no T3 items are included for any candidate in the US Senate, US House 1-6 or Governor races: every item comes from the T1 voters' pamphlet, official .gov pages or official roll-call pages. Campaign websites are recorded from the pamphlet but were not fetched for positions, for any candidate. oregonlive.com and apnews.com are rejected by the search proxy as allowed_domains and could not be searched for anyone. Incumbency: pamphlet occupation 'U.S. Representative' and bonamici.house.gov biography. congress.gov is robots-blocked for WebFetch, so votes cite clerk.house.gov roll calls; the same two roll calls are used for every Oregon House incumbent. Nominated by Democrat and Working Families per pamphlet; matches inventory.
